01 / 研究成果

论文与专利

人工智能、数学建模、信号处理与嵌入式实现的研究成果；阵列声波是部分方法的应用场景。

A / 学术论文

已发表与已接收的工作

012026

期刊论文 · 已发表

Neighborhood Width Transform: A Structural Stability Framework for Peak Selection in Noisy 1D Coherence Curves

Sicheng Li, Zhaohui Ye

Mathematics, 14(12), 2156, 2026

提出邻域宽度变换，将含噪一维相干曲线的谱峰选择建模为结构稳定性问题。

S. Li and Z. Ye, “Neighborhood Width Transform: A Structural Stability Framework for Peak Selection in Noisy 1D Coherence Curves,” Mathematics, vol. 14, no. 12, art. no. 2156, 2026, doi: 10.3390/math14122156.

022026

期刊论文 · 已接收

Online-Adaptive Filtering in STC Processing For Real-Time Logging While Drilling System

Sicheng Li, Zhaohui Ye

IEEE Embedded Systems Letters, doi: 10.1109/LES.2026.3730142

设计在线自适应滤波方法，并针对嵌入式系统的实时计算需求进行实现。阵列声波处理是方法的验证场景。

S. Li and Z. Ye, “Online-Adaptive Filtering in STC Processing For Real-Time Logging While Drilling System,” in IEEE Embedded Systems Letters, doi: 10.1109/LES.2026.3730142.

032026

会议论文 · 已出版

Knowledge-Informed Neural Network for Peak Identification and Slowness Extraction in Array Acoustic Logging

Sicheng Li, Limeng Tian, Zhaohui Ye

2026 7th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (PRML), Urumqi, China, pp. 140–145, 2026

将先验知识融入神经网络，用阵列声波数据验证含噪峰值识别与参数提取。

S. Li, L. Tian and Z. Ye, “Knowledge-Informed Neural Network for Peak Identification and Slowness Extraction in Array Acoustic Logging,” 2026 7th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (PRML), Urumqi, China, 2026, pp. 140–145, doi: 10.1109/PRML71097.2026.11687294.
